protocol_class: direction screen; no repetition or release authority
order: d3 only after useful complete d2 direction
comparison: Frozen v113 same-request direction; original installed non-MTP output baseline. Preserve complete token IDs, usage, response, finish, route, capacity and free8GiB. Report Prefill seconds/token rate, externalTTFT, committed Decode rate, total.
stop: At completed P65 stop if Decode <=14.14897114978091*1.001; at any timing stage stop if Decode < v113*0.97. Any output/state/route/resource failure stops. Thresholds fixed now, no reruns to rescue negative direction.
acceptance: No counterfactual gain inferred. Tree/proposal/work counters and first-step top2/last-confidence costs are included in actual request. Useful complete d2 direction unlocks d3; final full50%-200% objective and independent-process repetition remain required.
tiny_boundary_policy: Keep linear proposals when maximum draft<2, first sequence<65 or planned nodes cross short/long boundary; existing fallback route and counts remain explicit.
rollback: A negative whole API closes this architecture version and removes unused tree prerequisites, restoring v113. No rank/threshold/width/depth/quantizer scan.
